context: A teacher and teen review a Pacific Coast history lesson
purpose: Teach: 太平洋/鎌倉/海上/球団/ライヴ/トーナメント/ソフトバンク/シカゴ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、おはようございます!昨日のソフトバンクの試合、見ましたか?延長まで行って凄かったんですよ。
lines.en: Good morning, teacher! Did you watch yesterday's SoftBank game? It went to extra innings, it was amazing.
lines.style: bright morning greeting, excited teenage chatter, eager to share

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: おはよう、桜さん。私もうちの球団を応援してるから、ちょっとだけライヴ中継を見たわよ。
lines.en: Good morning, Sakura. I support our home team too, so I watched the live broadcast for a bit.
lines.style: warm morning reply, friendly teacher tone, gently conversational

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やっぱり!来週からトーナメントも始まるし、今週は全然集中できそうにないです…。
lines.en: I knew it! The tournament starts next week too, so I don't think I can focus at all this week...
lines.style: playful teenage groan, half-joking complaint, animated delivery

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: こらこら、今日は鎌倉時代の授業よ。当時の海上交易について少し話しましょうね。
lines.en: Now now, today's lesson is on the Kamakura period. Let's talk a little about the maritime trade of that time.
lines.style: mock-stern redirect, affectionate teacher cadence, settling into lesson

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 鎌倉幕府の時って、もう太平洋側の港もちゃんと使われてたんですか?
lines.en: Back in the Kamakura shogunate's time, were the Pacific-side ports already being used properly?
lines.style: genuine curious question, polite student inflection, engaged tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、太平洋沿岸の港から船が出て、東国と西国を結ぶ海上ルートが発達していたのよ。
lines.en: Yes, ships left from Pacific coast ports, and maritime routes connecting the eastern and western provinces developed.
lines.style: scholarly explanation, measured teacher pace, warm and informative

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: へえ!そういえば、シカゴの博物館に鎌倉時代の刀があるってテレビで見ました。
lines.en: Wow! Speaking of which, I saw on TV that there's a Kamakura-period sword at a Chicago museum.
lines.style: genuine recall of a memory, brightening curiosity, casual teen tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: よく覚えてたわね。シカゴ美術館は日本美術のコレクションでも有名なのよ。
lines.en: You remembered well. The Art Institute of Chicago is famous for its Japanese art collection too.
lines.style: pleased praising tone, encouraging warmth, gently impressed

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあテスト頑張って、いつかシカゴまで本物を見に行きたいです!
lines.en: Then I'll work hard on the test, and someday I want to go all the way to Chicago to see the real thing!
lines.style: energized teenage resolve, bright determined tone, hopeful
